verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents agent-style automation ('create agents that run proactively based on triggers you set') and MCP-driven workflows across inbox/calendar, which implies some persistent automation beyond one-off prompts, plus admin governance over agent permissions. However, there's no explicit documentation of scheduling recurring/cron-like jobs, defining workflow cadence, or managing/viewing scheduled automations over time. Missing for 10: explicit recurring/scheduled job configuration, workflow run history/monitoring, and independent confirmation these trigger-based agents actually execute on a schedule rather than just event triggers.
